_inherited_budget_note: The 2026/27 budget was set by the outgoing Labour administration (Budget Council 2 Mar 2026). Reform UK won 7 May 2026 (ended Labour control held since 1974) and formed the Cabinet at Annual Council 20 May 2026, inheriting the budget; the first Reform-set budget will be 2027/28.

administration.note: Reform UK won the 7 May 2026 all-out election in a landslide (58 of 63; press reported 56-58, control not in doubt), ending Labour control held since 1974. Leader Cllr Karl Johnson. Part of the West Yorkshire Combined Authority (Mayor Tracy Brabin, Labour).

mtfs.intervention_status: None (no S114/EFS/BVN). The budget report explicitly contrasts Wakefield with neighbours Leeds and Bradford, both on EFS. HNB deficit GBP 4.1m managed by cross-subsidy.
mtfs._note: The GBP 431.4m net budget is a Fair Funding Review restatement (up from GBP 302.5m), not real growth.
mtfs._source: Wakefield Council 2026/27 Revenue Budget (doc s136158 + Budget Council 2 Mar 2026).
